name: nana800-mcp-server
description: Build and manage nana800.io no-code workflows: projects, blocks, run history and analytics exports
long_description:
MCP server for [nana800.io](https://nana800.io/en/), a no-code platform for backend logic and workflow automation. Workflows (schemes) are built from trigger and action blocks (nodes): webhooks, timers, HTTP requests, Telegram, Google Sheets, GPT and other integrations.

With it the assistant creates projects and schemes, adds, configures and connects blocks, exports and imports schemes as JSON, reads the OpenAPI document of scheme webhooks, reads the run history of schemes and blocks, reads the payment account and its transactions, and exports analytics events and users to CSV or JSON Lines files.

Needs a nana800.io API key from https://cloud.nana800.io/settings. Delete and remove tools can not be undone.
